name: linux-basic
description: Basic Linux environment agents can customize

name: esp-idf
description: ESP-IDF 5.5.1 with Espressif Xtensa and RISC-V QEMU; amd64 on Mac Docker emulation
dockerfile:
FROM ${BASE}
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq ca-certificates libglib2.0-0 libpixman-1-0 libsdl2-2.0-0 libslirp0 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]
RUN . $IDF_PATH/export.sh && python $IDF_PATH/tools/idf_tools.py install qemu-xtensa qemu-riscv32
WORKDIR /workspace
probe: . $IDF_PATH/export.sh >/dev/null && idf.py --version && qemu-system-xtensa --version && qemu-system-riscv32 --version && cp -a $IDF_PATH/examples/get-started/hello_world /tmp/hello && cd /tmp/hello && idf.py set-target esp32 && idf.py build
